stem: Increasing plant density raises yield per room on one cycle but also increases disease incidence, labor congestion, and environmental excursions. What is the strongest capacity conclusion?
choices: Capacity should be defined by sustainable process performance and risk, not plant count alone
The higher plant count is automatically superior
Disease incidence is unrelated to capacity
Labor and environmental limits should be ignored when yield rises
rationale: Operational capacity is constrained by environmental control, workflow, biosecurity, labor, and quality performance, not only physical floor space.
